Task charters

T1 — Define the widget model

kind behavioral size band 60–120 foundation high — common-root

GoalThe widget model type exists with closed validation.

Current behaviorNo widget model exists; callers hold untyped maps.

Desired behaviorA typed widget model validates closed and rejects an unknown field with a named defect.

Scope
  • the widget model type and its closed validation
  • the named defect returned for an unknown field
Out of scope
  • persistence of widgets
Acceptance criteria
  • validating a widget with an unknown field yields a defect naming the field
  • validating a well-formed widget returns no defect
Key interfaces
  • `Widget` — the model type callers construct
Traces
  • prd:widget/FR-1
  • design:widget-design#3.1
plan-task-id widget/001/T1

T2 — Serve widget lookups

kind behavioral size band 80–160 foundation medium — derived-internal blocked by T1 overlap accepted shares the serve surface with the reindex batch; both writers run under one lock

GoalLookups return the stored widget or a named miss.

Current behaviorNo lookup surface exists.

Desired behaviorA lookup returns the widget when present and a named miss when absent, never an empty success.

Scope
  • the lookup behavior over stored widgets
  • the named-miss result
Out of scope
  • caching of lookup results
Acceptance criteria
  • a lookup for a stored widget returns it
  • a lookup miss names the widget it did not find
Key interfaces
  • `Lookup` — the read surface
Traces
  • prd:widget/FR-2
  • corpus:SCAF-1
plan-task-id widget/001/T2

T3 — Query the widget index

kind behavioral size band 100–200 foundation low — derived-leaf blocked by T2

GoalA miss reports the queried key so the caller can distinguish absence from error.

Current behaviorA miss returns an empty result indistinguishable from an error.

Desired behaviorA query miss names the key it did not find and reports absence as a first-class outcome.

Scope
  • the query behavior over the index
  • the named-miss outcome distinct from an error
Out of scope
  • ranking of query results
Acceptance criteria
  • a query miss names the key it did not find
  • a query hit returns the stored widget
Key interfaces
  • `Query` — the index read surface
Traces
  • prd:widget/UB-1
plan-task-id widget/001/T3

T4 — Reindex widgets in one batch

kind behavioral size band 200–400 foundation low — derived-leaf blocked by T1 size accepted the reindex is one indivisible transaction over the whole store and cannot be split without leaving a half-built index overlap accepted shares the serve surface with the lookup task; both writers run under one lock

GoalThe whole widget store rebuilds its index atomically.

Current behaviorNo reindex exists; a corrupt index has no repair path.

Desired behaviorA reindex rebuilds the index in one transaction and either fully replaces the old index or leaves it untouched on failure.

Scope
  • the atomic reindex over the whole store
  • the all-or-nothing replacement on failure
Out of scope
  • incremental reindexing
Acceptance criteria
  • a completed reindex fully replaces the prior index
  • a reindex that fails partway leaves the prior index untouched
Key interfaces
  • `Reindex` — the atomic rebuild surface
Traces
  • prd:widget/FR-2
  • design:widget-design#3.1
